PRL. SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AT NELAMANGALA IN OS NO. 472/2023, AT ANNEXURE-F AND THE APPEAL PENDING BEFORE THE ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER,
DODDABALLAPUR SUB-DVN., DODDABALLAPUR, IN PTCL (NEL)
02/2021 AT ANNEXURE-G AND ETC.,
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP THROUGH VIDEO CONFERENCING / PHYSICAL HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM :
HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  ORAL ORDER 1.
The land which is the subject matter of the writ petition has been acquired for the purposes of Karnataka Industrial Area Development Board (for short, 'the KIADB').

Respondent No.4 herein filed W.P.No.4878/2024 (LA-KIADB) and submitted that he is the owner of the property and that a direction may be issued to the KIADB to pay him the compensation as per Section 29(2) of the NC:
2024:KHC:31463 Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, 1966 (Consent Award).
2.
The writ petition was allowed and respondent No.3 has been directed to pass a consent award.
However, the order in the said writ petition also stated that in case of any dispute with regard to the title of the property, the general award would stand restored.

3. The petitioners herein have filed the instant writ petition claiming that they are the owners of the property concerned and not respondent No.4 and consequently have prayed for the following reliefs:
"a. To issue writ of Mandamus against Respondent No.3 not to release the award amount in respect of land bearing Sy.No.205(Original Sy.No.45, then the land bearing Sy.No.45/14) measuring to an extent of 2 Acres of Obalapura Village,
Thyamagondlu Hobli, Nelamangala Taluk until final adjudication of respective right and share of the petitioners before the Hon'ble I Addl.

Prl. Senior Civil Judge at Nelamangala in OS.No.472/2023 at Annexure-F and the appeal pending before the Assistant NC: 2024:KHC:31463 Commissioner, Doddaballapur Sub-Dvn.,
Doddaballapur, in PTCL(NEL) 02/2021 at ANN-G. b.

entities.text: I Addl.,Prl.Senior Civil Judge at Nelamangala
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Admittedly, now there is a dispute raised by the petitioners herein regarding the ownership of the property.

The learned counsels for the petitioners NC: 2024:KHC:31463 and respondent No.4 submit that they will make the required claim before the Reference Court.

6. Hence, the following:
ORDER i. Respondent No.3 is directed to deposit the award amount before the Reference Court in accordance with law as expeditiously as possible.
